p.title: v59.99 the screener-universe mirror no longer changes with the calendar
p.symptom: From 2026-11-12 00:54Z every CI run failed in the data-pipeline gate ("screener-universe.json is in sync with SCREENER_DB"), so no revision was attested, GitHub Pages stopped deploying and the refresh scheduler's convergence step failed every 30 minutes; data commits kept landing on main but the live site stayed on the last attested revision for about 12 hours.
p.root_cause: scripts/sync-screener-universe.mjs wrote meta.currentness (CURRENT/STALE) from Date.now() into the checked-in mirror. Thirty days after lastBulkUpdate (2026-10-13) a rebuild said STALE while the file said CURRENT, so the drift check failed with no change to the source. The warn-only change to the static-db expiry gate (v59.97) did not cover this second place where the same review window was evaluated.
p.fix: The mirror carries only source fields (lastBulkUpdate, staleAfterDays); src/data/providers/screener.js derives the universe's currentness at read time from them, and the factor backtest's universePolicy carries staleAfterDays instead of the word. The mirror was regenerated.
p.violated_rule: A generated file compared in a gate must be a pure function of its sources (P1542 class: a lapsed review window is shown, never a deploy stop).
p.prevention: ci-data-pipeline-contract-check rebuilds the mirror in check mode with the clock moved a year ahead and requires no difference.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-data-pipeline-contract-check.mjs exits 0 (it exited 1 on origin/main at 2026-11-12); screener workbench, unit and expiry gates exit 0.

changelog: **Deploys no longer stop on day 31 after a universe review ({P}):** the screener-universe mirror held a clock-derived CURRENT/STALE word, so its drift check failed on 2026-11-12 with no source change and blocked CI attestation and Pages for about 12 hours; readers now derive it.
note: v59.99: screener-universe mirror is a pure function of its source
